tickets.title: Set up the local software factory
tickets.acceptance: Gitignored agent mailbox; tested weighted ticket scheduling; feature PR and gh merge workflow with standing review authorization.

tickets.title: Integrate upstream provenance, SVG format accuracy, and corner/cutout specifications
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream PR #223 (docs/exo-provenance.md), PR #235 (README.md, src/atelier/workspace.rs), PR #240 (docs/corner-tools.md), and EXO-CAD-013 / EXO-CAD-014 backlog specs from PR #232 and PR #239 into docs/rewrite-backlog.md; pass checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Integrate workspace profile external-change detection and concurrent migration hardening
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream codex/profile-reconcile-test (src/atelier/workspace_profiles.rs) for cross-process profile write serialization, external change detection, reload, and stale-restore prevention; pass checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Integrate portable fabric albedo textures and linear-light mipmaps
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream PR #208 (codex/fabric-textures: appearance.rs, fabrics_ui.rs, render.rs, cloth.wgsl, gpu_bench.rs, template.rs, tests/appearance.rs, docs/fabric-appearance.md); pass CPU and desktop checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Integrate persistent pattern piece ruler measurements
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream PR #227 (feature/persistent-pattern-measurements: measure.rs, authoring.rs, polygon.rs, linked.rs, geometry.rs, tests/persistent_pattern_measurements.rs, tests/persistent_pom_references.rs) cleanly with current main; pass CPU and desktop checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Integrate opt-in static physics-inspired mesh preparation
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream PR #230 (codex/physics-inspired-mesh-resolution), fixing PolygonPattern struct initializers (notches, seam_allowances, measurements) in src/mesh_resolution/mesh.rs, src/mesh_resolution/preparation.rs, and src/project.rs; pass CPU and desktop checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Integrate construction trims, repeat controls, and 2D/3D interior mesh pinning
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream codex/pin-trim-integration-review (combining PR #200, PR #212, PR #213, and PR #215) plus the top 4 commits of PR #215 (6a83b59..44a4631 for 2D board trim draft dragging and immutable material path index caching); pass CPU and desktop checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Integrate command palette and simulation reset guards for pending trim drafts
tickets.acceptance: Merge upstream PR #224 commits (0a7deb9..ef34209 in src/atelier.rs and src/atelier/command_palette.rs) on top of the trim and pin integration; pass CPU and desktop checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Extract UI-agnostic AtelierCore state and add cssimpler workspace dependency
tickets.acceptance: Decouple Atelier workspace state, worker channels, and transient tool drafts from eframe::App; add cssimpler dependency behind desktop feature without breaking CPU-only build.

tickets.title: Implement cssimpler Studio V2 app shell, dark/light CSS tokens, and wgpu viewport compositor
tickets.acceptance: Render exo-sample-3d 5-row/4-column Studio V2 layout via cssimpler::ui! and studio_v2.css with frameless WindowConfig and hybrid 3D wgpu / 2D board surface composition.

tickets.title: Port top menu bar, simulation transport, 3D/2D tool rails, radial menu, and command palette to cssimpler
tickets.acceptance: Route all 12 typed CommandId actions, pending-draft guards (FC-0008), tool switching, and corner tool Radius/Shape controls (FC-0002) through cssimpler.

tickets.title: Port left Asset/Piece Browser and right 5-category Object Browser to cssimpler
tickets.acceptance: Render bundled templates, Piece list, and 5-category Object Browser (2D Pattern, Sewing, 3D Form, Material, Environment) with workspace_profiles persistence (FC-0003).

tickets.title: Port right Property Editor Part 1 (Information, Selected Line, Arrange, Measurements, and Pins) to cssimpler
tickets.acceptance: Connect numeric point constructions, notches/allowances, persistent ruler measurements (FC-0005), and contour/interior pins (FC-0007) to cssimpler property accordions.

tickets.title: Port right Property Editor Part 2 (Fabric & Appearance, Trims, Mesh Preparation, and Avatar Diagnostics) to cssimpler
tickets.acceptance: Connect FabricAppearance albedo textures (FC-0004), construction trims & repeat controls (FC-0007), static mesh preparation (FC-0006), and avatar collision diagnostics to cssimpler.

tickets.title: Guard document replacement against unapplied construction trim drafts
tickets.acceptance: New/Open/Close detect an unapplied trim draft; discard confirmation and cancellation retain existing lifecycle semantics, with meaningful CPU coverage.

tickets.title: Expose shared native workspace command registry through CPU library
tickets.acceptance: Public typed command registry and availability use same definitions as Atelier; CPU-only integration tests import library API; no UI or worker dependency introduced.

tickets.title: Extract UI-independent viewport gesture controller
tickets.acceptance: Plain logical coordinates and explicit viewport ownership drive real board pan/zoom first; later hit-testing and 3D staging remain explicit slices with tests.
tickets.notes: First slice PR14 merged after all6 CI checks and independent review: metric board transform, captured pan, anchored zoom. Broad ticket remains open: adapter wiring, hit-testing, staged edits and 3D gestures.

tickets.title: Implement CPU corner tooling and synchronized seam cutout domain operations
tickets.acceptance: Reviewable original Rust geometry transactions for corner radius/shape and synchronized cutouts; preserve semantic references or refuse explicitly; slice delivery must not imply whole-ticket completion.

tickets.title: Independently review native UI and hardening PRs
tickets.acceptance: Review PR12 and incoming native UI source/lifecycle changes with pinned evidence, actionable findings, and validated fixes before merge.

tickets.title: Verify upstream hardening and integrate avatar acceptance evidence
tickets.acceptance: Pin existing glTF/worker changes, preserve avatar import acceptance limits and review PR12 with passing CI.

tickets.title: Replace egui and eframe completely with cssimpler desktop UI
tickets.acceptance: Desktop entry points use real cssimpler UI; direct wgpu rendering/compute; no egui or eframe packages in all-features dependency graph or regenerated lockfile; preserve CPU builds and real authoring/worker behavior. No legacy egui feature.

tickets.title: Remove eframe reexports from GPU simulation and headless GPU CLI
tickets.acceptance: Compute modules and headless GPU entry use pinned direct wgpu30 dependency; shader/compute behavior preserved. This prerequisite does not complete full egui removal.

tickets.title: Wire cargo run and cloth-fit --view to launch reworked Studio V2 cssimpler UI
tickets.acceptance: cargo run launches css_editor; cloth-fit --view launches css_runner; passes CPU and desktop checks; PR22 merged

tickets.title: Integrate cssimpler native 3D GPU viewport into Studio V2
tickets.acceptance: Upgrade cssimpler to 3D_implementation with gpu-viewport; render 3D garment directly on GPU; pass CPU and desktop checks

tickets.title: Port CAD corner rounding toolbar and synchronized seam cutouts from upstream
tickets.acceptance: Integrate PR #240/#239/#232 logic and tests into src/garment and css_ui rails; pass CPU checks

tickets.title: Port CAD cut-and-sewn darts and seam allowance guides from upstream
tickets.acceptance: Integrate PR #1/#6/#7/#66 darts and seam allowance geometry and independent tests; pass CPU checks

tickets.title: Audit and repair CPU-only regression baseline on Windows
tickets.acceptance: Run locked CPU checks with two jobs/threads; fix isolated verified failures outside paused UI/CAD areas and record exact evidence in a PR.

tickets.title: Document and check Windows contributor prerequisites
tickets.acceptance: Read-only prerequisite checker explains missing Rust/MSVC/Git/Python/GitHub CLI or auth; contributor instructions tested without GPU; separate PR.

tickets.title: Establish USD-first static interchange contract and independent fixtures
tickets.acceptance: Inspect USD runtime options and static avatar/garment scope, document supported versus planned behavior, add independent fixtures and validation for the chosen first USD slice; no UI/CAD overlap.

tickets.title: Wire CSSimpler USD 3D viewport into Studio V2 and FEM Workshop
tickets.acceptance: Update cssimpler dependency to latest main (bba002c) with gpu-viewport feature; bind garment USD scenes to cssimpler native USD viewport via with_usd_viewport in css_editor and css_runner; pass CPU and desktop checks.

tickets.title: Remove duplicate SVG 3D rendering from cssimpler editors
tickets.acceptance: Both native editors retain their USD viewport registration and contain no SVG 3D mesh generation; 2D SVG boards remain; desktop compilation passes

tickets.title: Fix CSSimpler performance regressions: backend selection, decoupled workers, control signaling, and idle invalidation
tickets.acceptance: Wire GPU simulation backend into css_runner; decouple ReferenceSolver into background worker; fix pause/reset worker control signaling and eliminate per-frame scene resubmission; return Clean when idle in update_runner; re-wire ui_perf_smoke and smoke flags; pass CPU and desktop checks.

tickets.title: Integrate modular Studio V2 CSS components and true 2D metric pattern board in css_runner to match EXO Studio V2 layout and styling
tickets.acceptance: Replace inline stubs in css_runner with modular Studio V2 top bar, tool rails (3D & 2D), left asset & piece browser, right 5-category object browser and property accordions; render true 2D metric pattern board SVG from garment panels; update studio_v2.css to match EXO Studio V2 layout and tokens; pass CPU and desktop checks and open PR.

tickets.title: Redesign CAD vector icons, remove rail badge overflows, and fix top-bar / right-dock layout
tickets.acceptance: Replace unclear icons with standard CAD symbols (open hand grab, crisp white seam stitches, dress form avatar, target cam reset, clean scissors/fillet); eliminate rail-overflowing badges and readouts; fix horizontal alignment in top bar right; add right dock scrollbar breathing room; pass CPU and desktop checks.

tickets.title: 2D pattern board functional interactive overhaul: edge points, Bézier handles, selection highlights, and isotropic aspect-ratio preservation
tickets.acceptance: Render smooth cubic Bézier boundary paths with tangent stalks and interactive handles; draw CAD vertex knobs for all contour points; render piece and edge selection highlights; enforce isotropic 1:1 metric aspect ratio via SVG preserveAspectRatio and symmetric viewbox expansion to eliminate stretching; pass CPU tests and desktop compilation.

tickets.title: Complete CAD vector icon set & tool rail parity matching EXO Studio V2
tickets.acceptance: Add high-contrast vector SVG icons for all standard CAD and 3D tools (select arrow, curvature point, polygon, circle, dart, notch, seam allowance, pleats, free sew, tape measure, pin, cloth pull, dress form); map tools in 3D and 2D rails with standard CAD hotkeys and active states; pass tests.

tickets.title: Unify normal cargo run (css_editor) and cloth-fit (css_runner) under modular Studio V2 layout and CSS styling
tickets.acceptance: Refactor css_editor to consume shared Studio V2 top bar, tool rails, 3D viewport, 2D pattern board, and right-dock properties accordions; verify both binaries build cleanly without egui.
